title: ProofScript computation function recording 0.4.0
$comment: This is the function provenance object inside a computation component. It shares native expression encoding with proof documents; the computation execution envelope and proofscript-json-v1 ABI are unchanged. This schema validates shape only; the decoder additionally checks reference ownership, structural postorder and exact root targets. Metadata values are opaque scalars. Old recording versions require lake build <Library>:ps4html.
